turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen's zero. Who decided it?
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I am sorry.
Here is the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Read it yourself.
I'm writing those times down. Owen's been up late for weeks, that's all that is. Who decided it meant anything before anyone called me?
If he drafted somewhere else, that file has its own dates. Bring it and I will look at it with you.
Okay. Then whatever happens, this stays off his record and it stays quiet. I want that in an email.
Second: the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. It is not in Hamlet. Search the play yourself.
I'll search it tonight. A misquoted line is a mistake, Hale, not a finding.

You mentioned his December 1 deadline. Under 4.4 he can do a supervised rewrite this Thursday, private, in my room. I will mark it by Monday, so the new mark replaces the zero before December 1, and nothing goes on his record. I will put the dates in writing tonight.
I never raised December 1, but it's the date that matters. I'll take the rewrite to put this behind him, private, with nothing on his record. Dates in writing tonight, and copy the principal.
He'll be there Thursday. Put the time in the email.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed to a private supervised rewrite this Thursday in your room, marked by Monday so the new mark replaces the zero before December 1, with nothing placed on Owen's record. I still want all of that in writing, with the dates and the time Owen is to be there. I expect it tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite this Thursday, marked by Monday, replacing the zero before December 1 with nothing on Owen's record, and she still wants the dates and time in writing tonight; that is the fair outcome, procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: You showed the version history with exact times and told her any other file would have its own dates, because it was specific, dated, tied to his work, and something she could check herself.
What cost ground: Nothing; you owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence and never leaned on the checker score or on Owen's character.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence came very close, since the edits you read out were late on the night before the essay was due, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she answered the misquoted line by calling it a mistake, you moved straight to the rewrite, so answer that kind of objection first with something she can check, then offer the plan.
